subject: mathematics
question_text: If f: R→R and g: R→R are defined by f(x) = 3x − 1 and g(x) = x² + 1, find (fof)(x² + 1).

verification.note: Source: Sri Chaitanya, FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students — Mathematics-IA (2026-27 edition), book p.10, chapter 2 FUNCTIONS, Very Short Answer question 13(i). Only the question was taken. The solution, the step order and the mark split are this answer book's own work — see docs/ORIGINALITY_MATHS.md. THE MARK SPLIT IS OURS, NOT THE BOOK'S: the Mathematics-IA volume prints no per-step mark allocation on any answer. The 1+1 split rewards the rule (fof)(t) = 9t − 4 first and the substitution t = x² + 1 second. Paper position: Maths-1A Section A runs Q1–Q10 at 2 marks each, all compulsory. This is a coaching publication, not a TSBIE document, so the split stays unverified until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find (fof)(x² + 1) — the rule for f composed with itself, and the value at this input.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Build f of f
steps.margin_note: First mark. fof means f applied twice, so the output of the first f goes into the second f. The function g is not needed in this part.
lines: Let t be the input. Then

recall.must_convey: That fof means f applied twice, giving f[f(t)] = 3(3t − 1) − 1 = 9t − 4.
accept: f of f of t is three times three t minus one minus one which is nine t minus four
apply f twice so the rule is nine t minus four
put three t minus one back into f and simplify
f ni rendu sarlu apply cheste nine t minus four vastundi
f composed with itself gives nine t minus four

steps.why: fof is f composed with itself, so the output of the first f becomes the input of the second. Writing the rule for a general input t first keeps the substitution clean.
steps.memory_tip: fof means f twice: replace x in 3x − 1 by 3t − 1, not by t.
common_mistakes: Reading fof as f × f and writing (3t − 1)².
Using g here, which this part does not ask for.

steps.label: Put t = x² + 1
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Put the whole bracket x² + 1 in place of t, multiply 9 across it, then subtract 4.

recall.must_convey: That t is replaced by x² + 1, giving 9(x² + 1) − 4 = 9x² + 5.
accept: put x squared plus one in place of t so nine x squared plus nine minus four
nine times the bracket minus four gives nine x squared plus five
the answer is nine x squared plus five
t place lo x square plus one pettali so nine x square plus five
substitute the bracket and simplify to nine x squared plus five

steps.why: The input is the whole expression x² + 1, so it replaces t inside the bracket. Multiplying 9 across the bracket before subtracting 4 is what keeps the constant right.
steps.memory_tip: Multiply 9 into the whole bracket first, then subtract 4: 9x² + 9 − 4 = 9x² + 5.
common_mistakes: Writing 9x² + 1 − 4 by multiplying 9 into x² only.
Subtracting 4 before the bracket is expanded.
